liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): Clipped near the end of the jam before the final verse; Reviewer identifies this as their favorite track from the show [10][13][19]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (2 reviews): Languid exploratory Eyes leads to a textured space jam; Performance is described as a slammin' but short rendition [12][15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Jerry wails on the wah during the outro jam [9]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Slower tempo allows Jerry and Phil to build melodious lines [9]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Performance is characterized as sublime [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-29.137373.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 200 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1977-10-29.sbd.cribbs.28613.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: A splice is present in the Good Lovin' recording [20]
- **gd1977-10-29.148908.betty-board.anon.noel.t-flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd77-10-29.maizner.vernon.8035.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 4.69/5 by 16 [7]. Said about its sound: File is slightly smaller, possibly due to faster tracking speed [11]

## Around the show

- Drum break occurs between the molten Sugar Mag and Saint Stephen [12]
- Reviewer lived in DeKalb and attended the concert in person [13]
- Audience was primarily NIU students, not a typical Dead crowd [14]
- Crowd stood for the first notes of Bertha and never sat down [14]
- Reviewer calls it the happiest day of Phil's life [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-29.137373.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:92085) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat -> CDTransfer Info:CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02… [1]
- **gd1977-10-29.sbd.cribbs.28613.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Sean Cribbs; source: MSR>PCM>DAT>CDx?>EAC>WAV>FLAC [4]
- **gd1977-10-29.148908.betty-board.anon.noel.t-flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by PCM clone provided by anonymous Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel; source: Betty SBD > Reel Master > PCM > pcm clone [6]. Also: Eyes patch source was remastered to blend with the main tape; Steve Maizner recorded the show; Charlie Miller is thanked [6]
- **gd77-10-29.maizner.vernon.8035.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Maizner; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-990s [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by diskunion.net: [DAVE'S PICK VOLUME 33 EVANS FIELD HOUSE, N. ILLINOIS UNIVERSITY, DEKALB, IL 10/29/77 / GRATEFUL DEAD / グレイトフル・デッド / オールド](https://diskunion.net/rock/ct/detail/DFS230222-074) [22]
